verdict.rationale: Outlook's own mail API documents filtering, searching and sorting messages across folders or the user's entire mailbox, OData query parameters, and search folders. That covers filters and full-history scope. One community user found LLM-based search faster than Outlook's web search field, which is a comparative opinion rather than a documented failure, so it lowers confidence only. Missing for 10: documented search operator syntax, ranked or relevance-ordered results, evidence of fast search performance, and hands-on corroboration of precision in the end-user client.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Apps can conveniently [filter, search, or sort](query-parameters) messages in specific folders or the user's entire mailbox.
Query for messages and get them in a search folder
Apps can control the behavior of GET requests by using [OData query parameters](/en-us/graph/query-parameters).
